# advanced_temporal_pattern_recognition_and_forecasting_with_pandas.py

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.linear_model import Ridge
from sklearn.model_selection import TimeSeriesSplit
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from statsmodels.tsa.statespace.sarimax import SARIMAX
from darts import TimeSeries
from darts.models import Prophet
from darts.metrics import mape

# Load dataset
df: pd.DataFrame = pd.read_csv('daily_temperature.csv', parse_dates=['Date'])
df.set_index('Date', inplace=True)
df = df.asfreq('D')
df['Temperature'].interpolate(method='linear', inplace=True)

# Feature Engineering
df['DayOfYear'] = df.index.dayofyear
df['Lag1'] = df['Temperature'].shift(1)
df['Lag7'] = df['Temperature'].shift(7)
df['RollingMean7'] = df['Temperature'].rolling(window=7).mean()
df.dropna(inplace=True)

# Train-test split
train_size: int = int(len(df) * 0.8)
train: pd.DataFrame = df.iloc[:train_size]
test: pd.DataFrame = df.iloc[train_size:]

# Model 1: Ridge Regression
features: list = ['DayOfYear', 'Lag1', 'Lag7', 'RollingMean7']
X_train: pd.DataFrame = train[features]
y_train: pd.Series = train['Temperature']
X_test: pd.DataFrame = test[features]
y_test: pd.Series = test['Temperature']

ridge: Ridge = Ridge()
ridge.fit(X_train, y_train)
predictions_ridge: np.ndarray = ridge.predict(X_test)
rmse_ridge: float = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_test, predictions_ridge))

# Model 2: SARIMAX
sarimax: SARIMAX = SARIMAX(train['Temperature'], order=(1, 1, 1), seasonal_order=(1, 1, 1, 12))
sarimax_fit = sarimax.fit(disp=False)
predictions_sarimax: pd.Series = sarimax_fit.predict(start=len(train), end=len(train)+len(test)-1, dynamic=False)
rmse_sarimax: float = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_test, predictions_sarimax))

# Model 3: Prophet
series: TimeSeries = TimeSeries.from_dataframe(df, 'Date', 'Temperature')
train_series, val_series = series.split_before(0.8)
prophet: Prophet = Prophet()
prophet.fit(train_series)
forecast: TimeSeries = prophet.predict(len(val_series))
rmse_prophet: float = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(val_series.values(), forecast.values()))

# Visualization
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 7))
plt.plot(test.index, y_test, label='Actual')
plt.plot(test.index, predictions_ridge, label='Ridge')
plt.plot(test.index, predictions_sarimax, label='SARIMAX')
plt.plot(val_series.time_index, forecast.values(), label='Prophet')
plt.legend()
plt.title('Temperature Forecasting')
plt.xlabel('Date')
plt.ylabel('Temperature')
plt.show()

# Print RMSE
print(f'Ridge RMSE: {rmse_ridge}')
print(f'SARIMAX RMSE: {rmse_sarimax}')
print(f'Prophet RMSE: {rmse_prophet}')
